sn22.57:1.3: The “seven” are the four noble truths from the previous discourse, plus the “gratification” triad from [sn22.26]().
sn22.57:18.1: The verb “examine” (_upaparikkhati_) is frequently used for someone who has learned the teachings, then internally reflects on their meaning.
sn22.57:18.2: These three, along with the aggregates, are the major wisdom topics, mentioned together also at [mn115:3.3](). More commonly, the aggregates, sense fields, and elements are mentioned as a summary of the Buddha’s wisdom teachings ([sn8.12:3.2](), [sn35.31:1.21](), [thig5.8:2.2](), etc.).
